Multienrichment of transcript and protein pathways across SLE and DM

Multienrichment of transcript and protein pathways across SLE and DM. The central network displays enriched pathway clusters, connected to pathway gene loci in each pathway cluster. Pathway clusters are labeled by cohort: “SLE” indicates enrichment specific to SLE, “DM” is specific to DM, and “SLEDM1” indicates enrichment across SLE and DM. Two signal analysis clusters are labeled “SLEDM2” and “SLEDM3,” which also indicate enrichment across SLE and DM. Nodes are purple or dark purple for SLE, and gold or orange for DM. Lighter color nodes (purple or gold) indicate gene loci identified by pathway enrichment, darker color nodes (dark purple and orange) for signaling analysis, and multiple colors for genes identified by multiple approaches. Node outlines indicate direction of change, red for up‐regulation and blue for down‐regulation. Heatmaps beside each cluster show expression changes versus healthy controls in the respective disease cohort. Heatmap rows are split by node colors. DM, dermatomyositis; IL, interleukin; SLE, systemic lupus erythematosus; TLR, Toll‐like receptor
